say:0:1410422001:0.text: So this is the commoner's area... and with this mark, I can't enter the city.
say:0:1410422001:0.source_cn: 看来这里是平民的所在地，带着这个印记，我暂时无法返回城区。
say:0:1410422001:0.male: So this is the commoner's area... and with this mark, I can't enter the city.

say:1:1410422002:0.text: Oh, could that be where the commoners receive Divine Dew?
